scope: Technical interpretation of the ProstateX-0038 ADC physical-plane diagnostic; no clinical or anatomical review
interpretation: The irregularity is not numerical tolerance noise. One expected 3-mm plane is absent between InstanceNumber 18 and InstanceNumber 16, producing one physical 6-mm gap in an otherwise regular 3-mm series.
frozen_protocol_action: Exclude ProstateX-0038 from the paired primary analysis as a post-download hard-check failure, retain the patient in outer fold 1, do not replace or move it, and do not fill or synthesize the missing plane.
supplementary_option: A separately prespecified nonuniform-plane sensitivity method could be developed later, but it must not be introduced ad hoc into the frozen primary analysis.
limitations: The cause of the absent plane is unknown.
This finding does not assess anatomy, image quality, labels, or clinical suitability.
